name: kodama
description: A portable, provider-neutral multi-agent pack. One orchestrator, eight specialists, zero lock-in.
author: amergrgic
highlights: 9 purpose-built agents with clear permission boundaries
Structured delegation with success criteria and feedback loops
Project memory persists across sessions automatically
Safe by default — read-only agents stay read-only

setup.onInstall: ./setup.sh --no-alias --no-default && cd ui && npm install && npm run build
setup.onUpdate: ./setup.sh --no-alias --no-default && cd ui && npm install && npm run build
